title: React
line: Components, props, state and effects in an app built with Vite.

project.title: A flashcard app
project.brief: Build a flashcard app with Vite on your own. Cards come from an array, a click flips the card, a form adds new ones and an effect counts the seconds you have studied.
checks: npm run build finishes with no errors
Cards render from an array with a key on each
A form adds a card and an effect with a cleanup runs the study timer

lessons.title: Start a React app with Vite
lessons.goal: Teach a JavaScript learner to create a React app with npm create vite@latest, start it with npm install and npm run dev, and put their own heading in src/App.jsx.
lessons.passes: package.json lists react and vite and App.jsx returns a new heading.

lessons.title: Write JSX
lessons.goal: Teach JSX in React, with one root element, className and JavaScript in braces, by building an animal fact card that shows a name, a weight and a picture.
lessons.passes: App.jsx returns a card with a className and at least two values in braces.

lessons.title: Split a page into components
lessons.goal: Teach React function components, export and import by building a food truck page from Header, Menu and Footer components in their own files.
lessons.passes: Header, Menu and Footer each live in a file and App renders all three.

lessons.title: Pass data with props
lessons.goal: Teach React props and destructuring by writing a MenuItem component with name and price props and using it for three dishes on the food truck page.
lessons.passes: MenuItem reads name and price props and is rendered three times.

lessons.title: Clicks and state
lessons.goal: Teach React click handlers and useState by building a light switch, a button that flips a room between light and dark and changes its own label.
lessons.passes: A useState value flips on each click and the label follows it.

lessons.title: State that counts
lessons.goal: Teach updating React state from the previous value, with several useState calls, by building a scoreboard for two teams with a reset button.
lessons.passes: Each team has its own state and reset sets both scores to zero.

lessons.title: Render a list
lessons.goal: Teach rendering lists in React with map and a key by showing a to-do list from an array of objects, with done items struck through.
lessons.passes: The to-dos render through map and each item has a unique key.

lessons.title: Forms and controlled inputs
lessons.goal: Teach React controlled inputs, onChange and onSubmit by adding a form to the to-do list that appends a new item and clears the box.
lessons.passes: Submitting the form adds one to-do to state and empties the input.

lessons.title: Share state between components
lessons.goal: Teach lifting state up in React by building a searchable list of dog breeds where a SearchBox and a BreedList share one query held by their parent.
lessons.passes: The parent holds the query and passes it to both child components.

lessons.title: Effects
lessons.goal: Teach React useEffect with a dependency array and a cleanup function by building a clock that ticks every second with setInterval.
lessons.passes: The effect starts one interval and its cleanup calls clearInterval.
